attempts.actual_result: T-33 lint found callback-state narrowing, optional legacy browser API typing and an unsafe test matcher assignment.

attempts.actual_result: ESLint passed, but Prettier found the QA ledger edited while the check was running.

attempts.actual_result: T-34 build found the delete callback renamed at the call site but not in the DataControls signature.

attempts.actual_result: Next build then caught Playwright-only exact option in a Testing Library getByRole call.

attempts.actual_result: T-34 lint rejected shorthand void callbacks, directly invoked state-setting refresh in an effect, and a broad Function test cast.
